2610.07782.title: Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference: What It Costs, What It Buys, and When You Can Tell
2610.07782.paper_summary: Decomposing long-context inference across cooperating agents bounds the active KV cache per call rather than total evidence, which matters when KV-cache memory binds. Many such systems add a persistent tier storing and recalling reasoning traces, usually validated by an ablation reporting an accuracy gain. We measure both on one three-tier agent architecture. Decomposition delivers: peak KV working set of 14.3 MiB per query against 35.5 and 35.3 MiB for single-pass and retrieval-augmented baselines. The persistent tier does not: across eight controlled dataset pairs at n=100 per arm it costs +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] of peak cache and produces no detectable accuracy change (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]). We argue the null is structural: single-question benchmarks supply each item with its own evidence and score it independently, and correctness requires resetting stored traces between conditions, so recall has nothing informative to retrieve. Reaching it took four measurement corrections -- three inflating the apparent benefit, the fourth making an effect that size look resolvable -- none visible in the results table. We give the conditions an agent-memory ablation must satisfy and detection procedures that need no knowledge of the specific defect.
2610.07782.paper_summary_zh: 將長上下文推理分解到合作代理中，限制每次調用的活動 KV 快取，而不是總證據，這在 KV 快取記憶體受限時非常重要。許多此類系統增加了一個持久層，用於存儲和回憶推理痕跡，通常通過消融實驗來驗證其準確性增益。我們在一個三層代理架構上進行了雙方的測量。分解提供了：每次查詢的峰值 KV 工作集為 14.3 MiB，而單次通過和檢索增強基準分別為 35.5 和 35.3 MiB。持久層則沒有：在每個臂 n=100 的八個受控數據集對中，它的成本為 +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] 的峰值快取，並且未產生可檢測的準確性變化 (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046])。我們認為零假設是結構性的：單問題基準為每個項目提供其自己的證據並獨立評分，而正確性要求在條件之間重置存儲的痕跡，因此回憶沒有任何信息可供檢索。達到這一點花費了四次測量修正——三次膨脹了表面上的好處，第四次使得這樣的效果看起來可以解決——在結果表中均未顯示。我們給出了代理記憶消融必須滿足的條件以及不需要特定缺陷知識的檢測程序。
